fields.why: The cluster is set against background (no neighborhood cases in 10 years; 1-5 county cases a year) only as narrative context in a limited case series, so summary is the better reading; A's side-by-side comparison with a referent is defensible under the brief.

Follows from analytic_depth: the background counts frame the cluster rather than form an analyzed contrast. A's 'fixed referent' is defensible, though its across ('period') fits pair better than fixed referent.

Blastomycosis is an inhaled fungal infection presenting as respiratory illness (text) but can disseminate; the brief does not say whether TB/respiratory covers non-TB respiratory infections. Rule needed: TB/respiratory = TB plus other primarily respiratory infections not listed separately.

Patient symptoms, lab evidence and hospitalization come from the field investigation, so record abstraction or interview applies; A missed it. A's 'other' for the veterinarian's report of canine cases is a defensible addition, while B's quote (environmental assessments) is weak evidence for its value.

brief_issues: condition_group does not define the scope of TB/respiratory for fungal or other non-TB respiratory infections.
